effects.label: Burn
effects.description: Damages the recipient by a percentage of their MAX HP, once per tick, for the duration of the debuff. Creates a Damage Zone around the recipient, damaging any of their allies in the indicated radius by a percentage of their MAX HP every tick.The number of ticks per second increases with Skill Speed. This debuff can be stacked.

levels.text:
Attacks 1 enemy from a distance of 9m, dealing 122 damage. Casts a [1% Burn] debuff on the target, lasting 4s. The [Burn] ticks every 2s, damaging targets by 1% of their MAX HP per tick (up to 200% ATK). Also damages all of the target's allies in a 6m radius by 0.5% of their MAX HP per tick (up to 200% ATK).

bio: Madalea is the greatest exorcist in Amara – she may even be a little too great. She had to become Dusklit in order to master her powers, an act strictly forbidden by the Lightseeker Sacriat. Madalea didn’t care. She is the enemy of all Demons, and she will fight them, permission or no.
